correctness.rationale: Exact coefficient arithmetic in Q(omega) independently reproduces 210 pair intersections and the 36/9/12 point multiplicity census. Blowing up only 21 higher multiplicity points creates 42 smooth rational components with 132 ordinary nodes; every component has valency >=4, so the curve is stable, of genus 91. The 41-square reduced Laplacian is reconstructed from 36 direct double-point edges and 96 exceptional incidences. A rational Schur determinant and the derivative of an exact Laplacian polynomial agree on tree number 2^8 3^13 5^8 7 67^8. Prime-local exact Smith elimination with precision > determinant valuation at every relevant prime yields invariant factors 335,1005x4,36180x2,1013040; same exponents are obtained using two distinct deleted vertices. The delivered standalone checker is executed after extraction from the final ledger. The interpretation via Néron is conditioned on a proper regular split semistable unit-thickness smoothing.

value.rationale: The 21 mirrors of G26 are a distinguished geometric reflection arrangement, and the stable boundary obtained by resolving precisely all higher-multiplicity intersections is canonical for this construction. Its complete integral critical group is the natural finite invariant controlling Néron component groups in regular unit-thickness degenerations. The repeated 67-primary factor, coupled with distinct powers of 2 and 3, is not readable from multiplicity census alone, and the full Smith form is finer than the graph spectrum/tree count. This is a complete invariant of a natural curve, not an arbitrary parametrized slice or a textbook immediate calculation.
